qualifications: Authentication does not establish authorization; signing configuration does not establish verified signatures.
Immediate enforcement and cache propagation are separately scoped source descriptions, not silently resolved.
Permission-only fragments require containing-page applicability; metrics list logical ambiguity remains preserved.
Optional passkeys and fallback methods are not universal mandates; historical rollout is not a current enrollment receipt.
App address inheritance does not permit same-IP user access; disabled team synchronization retains membership/access.
Default TOTP parameters and strong SMS alternatives retain source qualifiers.
Structural headers and table separators map to surrounding reviewed semantics, not invented obligations.
All records remain reference-only, including metadata; no claimed global semantic deduplication.
